summary_text: In January 2026, two independent orders were placed on different dates (2026-01-24 and 2026-01-30). Both orders included Curd Yogurt and Vegetables. The first order was a weekend morning purchase of Milk, Curd Yogurt, and Vegetables. The second was a weekday afternoon purchase of Curd Yogurt, Vegetables, and Savouries Namkeens. Due to the limited number of observations (two independent dates), stable recurring patterns cannot be confirmed. The co-occurrence of Curd Yogurt and Vegetables appears in both orders, but this is insufficient to establish a durable preference or routine. No abandonment patterns are repeated across independent dates.
